definition: A finding is a report of a potential security issue detected in an AWS account, workload, or data.
A management event records a management operation performed on an AWS resource.
A VPC flow log captures information about IP traffic to and from network interfaces.
A delegated administrator is an account designated to manage GuardDuty for associated member accounts.
An event pattern defines which event data EventBridge uses to decide whether to send an event to a target.
A target is a resource or endpoint that receives events matching an EventBridge rule.
A trusted list identifies sources for which GuardDuty does not generate findings.
A threat list identifies known malicious sources that GuardDuty uses to generate findings.
A sample finding uses placeholder values to help test and understand GuardDuty findings.
